summary: Bridgecrest Auto Funding LLC and Bridgecrest Acceptance Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an October 8, 2026 Underwriting Agreement with Wells Fargo Securities, as representative of several underwriters, for notes issued by Bridgecrest Lending Auto Securitization Trust 2026-4. Publicly registered classes A-1 through D carry coupons of 4.370% to 6.46%; unregistered Class E notes price at 8.38%. Expected closing is October 22, 2026. Proceeds fund the purchase of auto retail installment contracts. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch spread pricing and collateral pool performance rather than deal terms.
